basic_info.description: This stunning Mediterranean home sits on a tree-lined street in coveted Balboa Terrace, just half a block from Ocean Avenue MUNI lines and minutes from Lakeside Village shops, Stonestown Galleria, West Portal, and top local schools. With easy access to Highway 280, commuting is a breeze. Filled with charming period details, the home features a spacious east-facing living room, formal dining room, and a large kitchen with a breakfast nook and additional eat-in area. Three generously sized bedrooms, a full bath, and a deck off the kitchen complete the top floor. An interior staircase leads to a large unwarranted family room, half bath, laundry area, and a huge garage with 3-car tandem parking and ample space for storage or future expansion. Sitting on a 4,647 sq. ft. lot (per tax records), this home offers incredible potential in a prime location!
